_readme: The i18n decision registry. This file is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for what was
decided; the dictionaries are the result of applying it, not the record of it.
It exists because the same decisions were reversed enough times that 'what was
decided' could no longer be reconstructed from the instruction stream. One
house-style reversal alone produced 117 A-to-B-to-A key changes, and one
reversal (bn c.deliverTo) happened entirely inside an uncommitted session, so
git cannot show it at all. That is what override_log is for.
STATUSES
LOCKED                 decided, applied, consistent. Tooling may not change it.
REVIEW                 two valid readings; needs a native speaker. IMMUTABLE to
tooling. Does NOT block the freeze.
INTENTIONAL_DIVERGENCE web and app deliberately differ. NOT a defect.
UNDECIDED              web and app differ and nobody has ruled. NOT a defect,
and NOT to be auto-reconciled.
RULES FOR ANY TOOL THAT READS THIS FILE
- No default. No decision='app', no decision='web', no 'latest wins'. A key
named by no decision is not touched, in either direction.
- web != app is not, by itself, a defect signal.
- A cross-language difference is not a defect unless a decision says the
languages must match.
- scope.rule is how affected keys are IDENTIFIED. A key list is the resolved
result of a rule, never a substitute for one: listing examples is exactly how
gu-orthography and gu-status under-scoped and had to be redone.
- Terminology is applied as explicitly authored per-key values, never as a
substitution over the target language. A blind target-word swap is what
produced the vastu grammar defects repaired by product-item-grammar.

razorpay-casing.concept: The Razorpay credential terms are Latin and Title Case wherever they appear, including inside a translated sentence.
razorpay-casing.rationale: The term is a proper noun the shopkeeper is hunting for on Razorpay's own dashboard, not an English common noun to be sentence-cased. Razorpay prints 'Key Secret'.

scope.rule: Every key whose value names a Razorpay credential. Resolved to the seven keys below. The term is Title Case in the label AND in the sentence; the surrounding sentence stays in its own language.

excluded.why: Not in the decision's stated scope. All five transliterate the term today, as hi did. Raised as razorpay-casing-other-languages; NOT applied by analogy.

override_log.reason: The shopkeeper must find the field on Razorpay's dashboard.
Matched the English source, which sentence-cases the status strings.
The reversal was partial: it reached the web and the no-secret strings but not the app's SecretSet strings, leaving six rows in conflict. Resolved as a proper noun.

gu-status-form.concept: Gujarati order/payment states: a standalone chip is bare and uninflected; a sentence or hint agrees in gender and number.
gu-status-form.rationale: A chip has no sentence subject to agree with. A hint is a sentence and does.

scope.rule: CHIP families (the value IS the state): ostatus.*, status.*, dash.orderStatus.*, pstatus.* -> bare. SENTENCE family: ostatus.hint.* -> agreeing with the subject, which is ordar (masculine). A sentence that merely MENTIONS a state (chelp.e7.a) is not in scope.

override_log.to: a rule over five states and four key families
override_log.reason: Naming two chips left accepted bare and out_for_delivery inflected, each instructed, neither statement aware of the other.

mr-status-register.concept: Marathi shopkeeper-facing status terminology uses the plain register, not the Sanskritic one.
mr-status-register.rationale: The audience is low-literacy readers on cheap phones. स्वीकारले and बाकी are what a shopkeeper says; स्वीकृत and प्रलंबित are bureaucratic.

scope.rule: The status-key families only (ostatus.*, status.*, dash.orderStatus.*, pstatus.*) — where the string IS the status term. A sentence that merely mentions a state is not in scope.

cross_language.why: Explicitly permitted: Marathi may differ from Gujarati where its own grammar or register requires. This difference must NOT be reported as a defect.

override_log.reason: Applied in the same pass that moved Gujarati to સ્વીકારેલ.
Register, not inflection: the Sanskritic form is wrong for this audience. Marathi is permitted to differ from Gujarati here.

gu-orthography.concept: Gujarati keeps the candra vowel on English loanwords — candra-O (U+0A91 / U+0AC9) and candra-E (U+0A8D / U+0AC5).
gu-orthography.rationale: Candra marks the English open-o and ash vowels. Either convention is defensible in Gujarati print; what is not defensible is one word spelled two ways on two screens.

scope.rule: A CORPUS INVARIANT, not a token list: for any English loanword written with a candra vowel anywhere in gu, the plain-vowel spelling of that same lemma must appear NOWHERE, on either surface. A new loanword inherits the rule without a new instruction, and the gate fails on the first inconsistent spelling. loanword_lemmas below is the resolved set as of locking, used to seed the check — not the definition of the rule.

product-item.concept: Gujarati: the count word for a product or a countable item; the mass word only for a mass or collective reading.
product-item.rationale: Scoped by what the ENGLISH says, the way the catalogue decision was: of nine Gujarati strings containing the word for 'list', only three were catalogue contexts.

scope.rule: Read the English source. Mass/collective reading ('everything you ordered', 'Not everything in stock?', a rupee value of goods) -> the mass word. A product or a countable item -> the count word. Never a substitution over the Gujarati: each affected key carries an explicitly authored value below, so gender and number agree. Enforced by scope.english against each surface's OWN English source, not by this key list: a new countable-item key that renders with the mass word fails the gate whether or not anybody adds it here. mass_keys is the ONE declared-exception list and every entry states its reason; there is no second exclusion mechanism to drift from it.

mass_keys.coedit.intro: English is 'everything you ordered' — the whole of the order as a body of goods, not a count of line items.
mass_keys.oedit.start: English is 'Not everything in stock?' — same mass reading.
mass_keys.coedit.cash: English says '{amount} of items were taken off', so the countable marker fires, but the reading is a rupee VALUE of goods — 'goods worth {amount}' — not a count of line items. Declared, not silently skipped.

excluded.why: Marathi already uses one word throughout and has no competing mass word in this sense — its mass word appears only in the category name for household goods. Nothing to decide; no term is introduced by analogy.

english.direction: ENFORCED ONE WAY ONLY: an English source that is countable must not render with the mass word. The reverse is NOT enforced — 'You have taken off everything' is mass English that correctly uses neither word, so requiring the mass word there would be a false positive.

product-item-grammar.concept: Repair the grammatical damage the bare product-word substitution did. Wrong under every candidate terminology answer.
product-item-grammar.rationale: The old nouns were neuter; the new ones are feminine. The nouns were replaced and the agreeing words around them were not. The Marathi oblique stem was not in the substitution list, so an oblique form became a vowel sign after a long vowel, which is not a legal Marathi word form.

scope.rule: Every string where the substituted noun left a disagreeing determiner, verb or case ending. Resolved by inspection to the ten rows below.

reject-not-cancel.concept: Reject and Cancel are different actions and may not share a word.

Resolved to the six keys below, which are the six the Bengali reconciliation ledger changed for this reason. Not every English occurrence of "reject": promo and photo moderation are a different act and are declared out of scope.

english_source_defect.en: Tell the customer why — it is sent to them with the cancellation.
english_source_defect.problem: The reject screen tells the shopkeeper a CANCELLATION notice went out. The English contradicts the action it sits under, so every language that translates it faithfully inherits the contradiction — bn reads বাতিলের (of the cancellation) beside ফিরিয়ে দিন (reject).
english_source_defect.status: OPEN — English source defect, not a translation decision.
english_source_defect.note: Raised by the Bengali semantic audit and pre-existing in the shipped app. Fixing it means changing the English and re-translating every language, which is a separate change; this decision only records why the key is excluded from the pin.

provenance.quote: REJECT is not CANCEL. This app treats them as different actions and a shopkeeper must not confuse them; web reads বাতিল (cancel).

approve-not-accept.concept: The shopkeeper APPROVES an order; the word is not the same as accepting a delivery.

scope.rule: A CONSTRAINT on an open review, not a value pin. chelp.e7.a on the gu and mr web keeps naming the approved state with the approve-word; the native reviewer who answers status-mentions-in-prose may revise that prose, but may not settle the prose/chip mismatch by collapsing the approve-word into the accept-word.

approve-not-accept.owns_no_values: Deliberate. status-mentions-in-prose (REVIEW) owns the exact strings and stays authoritative for them; this decision would be a competing owner if it pinned them, and a LOCKED pin would also end a question parked for a native speaker. It constrains the ANSWER, not the value.

constrains.permits: Any revision of the sentence, including a different approve-word.
constrains.forbids: Rendering the approved state with the accept-word — the word the ostatus.accepted chip uses. That collapse is what makes the shopkeeper's approval and a delivery being accepted the same act, which this decision exists to prevent.
constrains.forbidden_stems_source: The shared stem of ostatus.accepted (gu સ્વીકારેલ, mr स्वीकारले) and the app copy of chelp.e7.a (gu સ્વીકાર્યો, mr स्वीकारले).
constrains.current_approve_word_note: Recorded as evidence of what the constraint currently permits. It is NOT required: the reviewer may choose another approve-word.

unit-counter.concept: The selling counter, not the measurement dimension.

scope.rule: c.unit and common.unit only. cat.unitPlaceholder ('Unit (kg, piece…)') and ord.unitPrice are the measurement sense and are excluded.

prepaid-mechanism.concept: Prepaid names the mechanism the shopper used, not an abstract state.

brand-registry-split.concept: Two sets, not one: BRAND_KEYS are keys whose WHOLE value is English; BRAND_TERMS are English substrings that are protected wherever they appear.
brand-registry-split.rationale: The old single set was written for bare labels. The Latin-retention decision then extended the requirement to four sentences containing those labels, and nobody added them, so the gates did not protect the exact rows that later went into conflict.

scope.rule: BRAND_TERMS is a CASING check, not a translation requirement: if a value contains a protected term case-insensitively, it must contain it with exactly this casing. A language that has not adopted the Latin term is not failed by it. Keys in exceptions are skipped, with the reason stated.

exceptions.txn.upi: Lower case ON PURPOSE. txn.* is a family of inline words used mid-sentence — purchase, cash, upi, credit — parallel to status.pending. The Title Case label for the same thing is type.upi ('UPI'). The casing check found this on its first run; it is a false positive, recorded here rather than 'fixed', because changing it would break the family and read wrong in the sentence it sits in.

gu-accepted-wording.concept: Is the current Gujarati word for 'Accepted' the right one?
gu-accepted-wording.why_review: It appears in NEITHER surface's prior history — it is a word a decision introduced, and no native speaker has read it. The FORM rule (bare in chips) is locked; the WORDING is not.

superseded_rows.note: LOCKED is authoritative: the string is still immutable, under that decision rather than this one. Kept here as provenance so the open wording question is not lost.

gu-accepted-wording.protects_note: gu-status-form locks the FORM of this chip (bare, not inflected). The open question here is the WORD, and it stays open on the two rows that decision does not name.

gu-out-for-delivery-form.concept: 'Out for delivery' has no bare Gujarati form in the corpus — one candidate is masculine, the other neuter, neither is uninflected.
gu-out-for-delivery-form.why_review: Applying the bare-chip rule here would mean inventing a word, which is what produced gu-accepted-wording. Left as it stands rather than invented.

status-mentions-in-prose.concept: chelp.e7.a names order states inside a sentence, and the words it uses do not match the chips.
status-mentions-in-prose.why_review: The gu web prose uses a Latin loan where the chip uses the Gujarati word; the mr prose uses the Sanskritic form that mr-status-register just replaced in the chips. Rewriting prose is not the same decision as fixing a chip, and neither gu-status-form nor mr-status-register claims it.

mr.chelp.e3.a: दुकान उघडा, हव्या त्या वस्तू कार्टमध्ये टाका, स्वतः घेऊन जाणे की डिलिव्हरी निवडा, आणि ऑर्डर करा दाबा. दुकानाला तुमची ऑर्डर मिळते आणि ते ती निश्चित करतात.
mr.chelp.e4.a: स्वतः घेऊन जाणे म्हणजे तुम्ही ऑर्डर स्वतः दुकानातून आणता, मोफत. डिलिव्हरी म्हणजे दुकान तुमच्यापर्यंत पोहोचवते, कधी थोड्या शुल्कासह — बरीच दुकाने ठरलेल्या रकमेच्या वर मोफत डिलिव्हरी देतात.
mr.chelp.e4.q: स्वतः घेऊन जाणे आणि डिलिव्हरीत काय फरक आहे?
mr.chelp.e5.a: तुम्ही खात्यावर (उधार), ऑनलाइन, किंवा रोख भरू शकता. खात्यावर घेतले तर ती रक्कम त्या दुकानातल्या तुमच्या चालू शिल्लकीत जमा होते, नंतर फेडता येते.
mr.chelp.e6.a: तुमचे खाते प्रत्येक दुकानातली तुमची उधारी एका ठिकाणी दाखवते. प्रत्येक खरेदी आणि भरणा नोंदला जातो, त्यामुळे तुमची शिल्लक नेहमी माहीत असते आणि तपशील पाहता किंवा डाउनलोड करता येतो.

whatsapp-latin-urdu.why_review: whatsapp-latin scopes itself to bn, gu, mr and hi. Extending it to ur by analogy is the implicit override the freeze forbids — and Urdu is right-to-left, so an embedded Latin word is a typographic decision, not just a spelling one.

consumer-faq-app-variants.concept: The consumer app answers chelp.e1, e8 and e9 in its own words, because the web's answers describe controls this app does not have.
consumer-faq-app-variants.rationale: The web answers point at 'Use my location', a language switch 'at the top' and a sun/moon toggle. The native directory has no GPS, the language picker is on Account, and the app has a single dark theme. Showing the web text would send a shopper hunting for buttons that are not there.

scope.rule: The chelp.* keys whose WEB answer names a control the native consumer app lacks. Resolved to the four keys below. Same namespace as every other FAQ string; the app dictionary simply holds a different value from the web, which is the mechanism eight other chelp answers already use.

english_source.note: Frozen. Reviewed line by line against the actual screens before translation; the location claim and the category-chip sentence were cut as unsupported, and no dark-mode battery claim was made.

translations.note: 9 languages x 4 keys, MACHINE-AUTHORED and read by nobody who speaks the language. Each names the real on-screen label in its own language (te/kn/ta render the Account tab as Profile) and keeps the microphone instruction conditional, because both mics are hidden where the device has no recognizer for the active language. Not approved, not LOCKED.

en.chelp.e1.a: Open the Shops tab and type a shop name or your city in the search box. If you see the 🎤 microphone, tap it and say the name instead of typing.
en.chelp.e8.a: Open the Account tab and pick your language under Language — the app remembers it on this phone. If you see the 🎤 microphone, tap it to search by voice. Wherever you see 🔊, tap it to have the text read aloud, and tap it again to stop.
en.chelp.e9.q: Can I change how the app looks?
en.chelp.e9.a: The app uses one dark screen everywhere, so there is nothing to switch. If your connection is slow or costly, open the Account tab and turn on Data saver to stop extra photos loading.

hi.chelp.e1.a: दुकानें टैब खोलें और सर्च बॉक्स में दुकान का नाम या अपना शहर लिखें। अगर 🎤 माइक दिखे, तो उसे दबाकर टाइप करने के बजाय नाम बोलें।
hi.chelp.e8.a: अकाउंट टैब खोलें और भाषा में अपनी भाषा चुनें — ऐप इसे इस फ़ोन पर याद रखता है। अगर 🎤 माइक दिखे, तो बोलकर खोजने के लिए उसे दबाएं। जहां भी 🔊 दिखे, उसे दबाने पर लिखा हुआ पढ़कर सुनाया जाता है; रोकने के लिए दोबारा दबाएं।
hi.chelp.e9.q: क्या मैं ऐप का रूप बदल सकता हूँ?
hi.chelp.e9.a: ऐप हर जगह एक ही गहरी स्क्रीन इस्तेमाल करता है, इसलिए बदलने के लिए कुछ नहीं है। अगर आपका कनेक्शन धीमा या महँगा है, तो अकाउंट टैब खोलकर डेटा सेवर चालू करें ताकि अतिरिक्त फ़ोटो लोड न हों।

bn.chelp.e1.a: দোকান ট্যাব খুলুন এবং সার্চ বক্সে দোকানের নাম বা আপনার শহর লিখুন। যদি 🎤 মাইক দেখতে পান, সেটি চেপে টাইপ করার বদলে নাম বলুন।
bn.chelp.e8.a: অ্যাকাউন্ট ট্যাব খুলুন এবং ভাষা-য় আপনার ভাষা বেছে নিন — অ্যাপ এটি এই ফোনে মনে রাখে। যদি 🎤 মাইক দেখতে পান, বলে খুঁজতে সেটি চাপুন। যেখানেই 🔊 দেখবেন, সেটি চাপলে লেখাটি পড়ে শোনানো হয়; থামাতে আবার চাপুন।
bn.chelp.e9.q: আমি কি অ্যাপের চেহারা বদলাতে পারি?
bn.chelp.e9.a: অ্যাপ সব জায়গায় একটিই গাঢ় স্ক্রিন ব্যবহার করে, তাই বদলানোর কিছু নেই। আপনার কানেকশন ধীর বা খরচসাপেক্ষ হলে অ্যাকাউন্ট ট্যাব খুলে ডেটা সেভার চালু করুন, যাতে বাড়তি ছবি লোড না হয়।

ta.chelp.e1.a: கடைகள் தாவலைத் திறந்து, தேடல் பெட்டியில் கடையின் பெயரையோ உங்கள் ஊரையோ தட்டச்சு செய்யுங்கள். 🎤 மைக் தெரிந்தால், அதை அழுத்தி தட்டச்சு செய்வதற்குப் பதிலாகப் பெயரைச் சொல்லுங்கள்.
ta.chelp.e8.a: சுயவிவரம் தாவலைத் திறந்து, மொழி-யில் உங்கள் மொழியைத் தேர்ந்தெடுங்கள் — ஆப் அதை இந்த ஃபோனில் நினைவில் வைக்கும். 🎤 மைக் தெரிந்தால், குரலில் தேட அதை அழுத்துங்கள். எங்கெல்லாம் 🔊 தெரிகிறதோ, அதை அழுத்தினால் எழுத்து வாசித்துக் காட்டப்படும்; நிறுத்த மீண்டும் அழுத்துங்கள்.
ta.chelp.e9.a: ஆப் எல்லா இடத்திலும் ஒரே இருண்ட திரையையே பயன்படுத்துகிறது, எனவே மாற்ற ஒன்றுமில்லை. உங்கள் இணைப்பு மெதுவாகவோ விலை அதிகமாகவோ இருந்தால், சுயவிவரம் தாவலைத் திறந்து டேட்டா சேவர் ஆன் செய்யுங்கள்; கூடுதல் படங்கள் ஏற்றப்படாது.

te.chelp.e1.a: దుకాణాలు ట్యాబ్ తెరిచి, సెర్చ్ బాక్స్‌లో దుకాణం పేరు లేదా మీ నగరం టైప్ చేయండి. 🎤 మైక్ కనిపిస్తే, దాన్ని నొక్కి టైప్ చేయడానికి బదులు పేరు చెప్పండి.
te.chelp.e8.a: ప్రొఫైల్ ట్యాబ్ తెరిచి, భాష లో మీ భాషను ఎంచుకోండి — యాప్ దీన్ని ఈ ఫోన్‌లో గుర్తుంచుకుంటుంది. 🎤 మైక్ కనిపిస్తే, మాట్లాడి వెతకడానికి దాన్ని నొక్కండి. ఎక్కడ 🔊 కనిపించినా, దాన్ని నొక్కితే రాసినది చదివి వినిపిస్తుంది; ఆపడానికి మళ్లీ నొక్కండి.
te.chelp.e9.a: యాప్ అంతటా ఒకే ముదురు స్క్రీన్ వాడుతుంది, కాబట్టి మార్చడానికి ఏమీ లేదు. మీ కనెక్షన్ నెమ్మదిగా లేదా ఖరీదుగా ఉంటే, ప్రొఫైల్ ట్యాబ్ తెరిచి డేటా సేవర్ ఆన్ చేయండి; అదనపు ఫోటోలు లోడ్ కావు.

kn.chelp.e1.a: ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳು ಟ್ಯಾಬ್ ತೆರೆದು, ಸರ್ಚ್ ಬಾಕ್ಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂಗಡಿಯ ಹೆಸರು ಅಥವಾ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಊರನ್ನು ಟೈಪ್ ಮಾಡಿ. 🎤 ಮೈಕ್ ಕಂಡರೆ, ಅದನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿ ಟೈಪ್ ಮಾಡುವ ಬದಲು ಹೆಸರು ಹೇಳಿ.
kn.chelp.e8.a: ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್ ಟ್ಯಾಬ್ ತೆರೆದು, ಭಾಷೆ ಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಭಾಷೆಯನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆಮಾಡಿ — ಆ್ಯಪ್ ಇದನ್ನು ಈ ಫೋನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನೆನಪಿಡುತ್ತದೆ. 🎤 ಮೈಕ್ ಕಂಡರೆ, ಧ್ವನಿಯಿಂದ ಹುಡುಕಲು ಅದನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿ. ಎಲ್ಲಿ 🔊 ಕಂಡರೂ, ಅದನ್ನು ಒತ್ತಿದರೆ ಬರಹವನ್ನು ಓದಿ ಕೇಳಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಲು ಮತ್ತೆ ಒತ್ತಿ.
kn.chelp.e9.a: ಆ್ಯಪ್ ಎಲ್ಲೆಡೆ ಒಂದೇ ಕಡುಬಣ್ಣದ ಪರದೆಯನ್ನು ಬಳಸುತ್ತದೆ, ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಬದಲಾಯಿಸಲು ಏನೂ ಇಲ್ಲ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕನೆಕ್ಷನ್ ನಿಧಾನ ಅಥವಾ ದುಬಾರಿಯಾಗಿದ್ದರೆ, ಪ್ರೊಫೈಲ್ ಟ್ಯಾಬ್ ತೆರೆದು ಡೇಟಾ ಸೇವರ್ ಆನ್ ಮಾಡಿ; ಹೆಚ್ಚುವರಿ ಫೋಟೋಗಳು ಲೋಡ್ ಆಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

ml.chelp.e1.a: കടകൾ ടാബ് തുറന്ന്, സെർച്ച് ബോക്സിൽ കടയുടെ പേരോ നിങ്ങളുടെ നഗരമോ ടൈപ്പ് ചെയ്യുക. 🎤 മൈക്ക് കണ്ടാൽ, അത് അമർത്തി ടൈപ്പ് ചെയ്യുന്നതിന് പകരം പേര് പറയുക.
ml.chelp.e8.a: അക്കൗണ്ട് ടാബ് തുറന്ന്, ഭാഷ-യിൽ നിങ്ങളുടെ ഭാഷ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക — ആപ്പ് അത് ഈ ഫോണിൽ ഓർത്തുവെക്കും. 🎤 മൈക്ക് കണ്ടാൽ, ശബ്ദത്തിലൂടെ തിരയാൻ അത് അമർത്തുക. എവിടെ 🔊 കണ്ടാലും, അത് അമർത്തിയാൽ എഴുത്ത് വായിച്ചു കേൾപ്പിക്കും; നിർത്താൻ വീണ്ടും അമർത്തുക.
ml.chelp.e9.a: ആപ്പ് എല്ലായിടത്തും ഒരേ ഇരുണ്ട സ്ക്രീൻ ഉപയോഗിക്കുന്നു, അതിനാൽ മാറ്റാൻ ഒന്നുമില്ല. നിങ്ങളുടെ കണക്ഷൻ പതുക്കെയോ ചെലവേറിയതോ ആണെങ്കിൽ, അക്കൗണ്ട് ടാബ് തുറന്ന് ഡാറ്റാ സേവർ ഓൺ ചെയ്യുക; അധിക ഫോട്ടോകൾ ലോഡ് ആകില്ല.

mr.chelp.e1.a: दुकाने टॅब उघडा आणि सर्च बॉक्समध्ये दुकानाचे नाव किंवा तुमचे शहर लिहा. 🎤 माइक दिसला तर तो दाबून टाइप करण्याऐवजी नाव बोला.
mr.chelp.e8.a: अकाउंट टॅब उघडा आणि भाषा मध्ये तुमची भाषा निवडा — ॲप ती या फोनवर लक्षात ठेवते. 🎤 माइक दिसला तर बोलून शोधण्यासाठी तो दाबा. जिथे 🔊 दिसेल तिथे तो दाबल्यावर मजकूर वाचून ऐकवला जातो; थांबवण्यासाठी पुन्हा दाबा.
mr.chelp.e9.q: ॲप कसे दिसते ते बदलता येईल का?
mr.chelp.e9.a: ॲप सगळीकडे एकच गडद स्क्रीन वापरते, त्यामुळे बदलण्यासारखे काही नाही. तुमचे कनेक्शन मंद किंवा महाग असेल तर अकाउंट टॅब उघडून डेटा सेव्हर चालू करा; म्हणजे जादा फोटो लोड होणार नाहीत.

gu.chelp.e1.a: દુકાનો ટૅબ ખોલો અને સર્ચ બૉક્સમાં દુકાનનું નામ કે તમારું શહેર લખો. 🎤 માઇક દેખાય તો તેને દબાવીને ટાઇપ કરવાને બદલે નામ બોલો.
gu.chelp.e8.a: એકાઉન્ટ ટૅબ ખોલો અને ભાષા માં તમારી ભાષા પસંદ કરો — ઍપ એને આ ફોન પર યાદ રાખે છે. 🎤 માઇક દેખાય તો બોલીને શોધવા તેને દબાવો. જ્યાં પણ 🔊 દેખાય, તેને દબાવતાં લખાણ વાંચીને સંભળાવાય છે; રોકવા ફરી દબાવો.
gu.chelp.e9.q: ઍપ કેવી દેખાય છે તે બદલી શકાય?
gu.chelp.e9.a: ઍપ બધે એક જ ઘેરી સ્ક્રીન વાપરે છે, એટલે બદલવા જેવું કંઈ નથી. તમારું કનેક્શન ધીમું કે મોંઘું હોય તો એકાઉન્ટ ટૅબ ખોલીને ડેટા સેવર ચાલુ કરો; જેથી વધારાના ફોટા લોડ ન થાય.

ur.chelp.e1.a: دکانیں ٹیب کھولیں اور سرچ باکس میں دکان کا نام یا اپنا شہر لکھیں۔ اگر 🎤 مائیک نظر آئے تو اسے دبا کر ٹائپ کرنے کے بجائے نام بولیں۔
ur.chelp.e8.a: اکاؤنٹ ٹیب کھولیں اور زبان میں اپنی زبان چنیں — ایپ اسے اس فون پر یاد رکھتا ہے۔ اگر 🎤 مائیک نظر آئے تو بول کر تلاش کرنے کے لیے اسے دبائیں۔ جہاں بھی 🔊 نظر آئے، اسے دبانے پر تحریر پڑھ کر سنائی جاتی ہے؛ روکنے کے لیے دوبارہ دبائیں۔
ur.chelp.e9.q: کیا میں ایپ کی شکل بدل سکتا ہوں؟
ur.chelp.e9.a: ایپ ہر جگہ ایک ہی گہری اسکرین استعمال کرتا ہے، اس لیے بدلنے کے لیے کچھ نہیں۔ اگر آپ کا کنیکشن سست یا مہنگا ہے تو اکاؤنٹ ٹیب کھول کر ڈیٹا سیور آن کریں؛ تاکہ اضافی تصویریں لوڈ نہ ہوں۔
